create_NVILAMultimodalProcessor: create an NVILAMultimodalProcessor instance with hf_config, server_args, and a ProcessorMixin for multimodal input processing
build_mm_tokens: build MultimodalSpecialTokens containing image and video token IDs from a tokenizer and pretrained config
process_mm_data_async: process multimodal data asynchronously from image and video inputs into input_ids and mm_items for NVILA model inference
load_mm_data: load multimodal data from image and video sources combined with a text prompt using specified multimodal tokens
process_and_combine_mm_data: process and combine multimodal data with frame sampling into mm_items, input_ids, and attention masks for batch processing
